items.description: When an audit catches drift (line counts, file existence, API shape), the correction must propagate to ALL doc claims, not just where I first wrote it. Discoveries in context/ are not enough — grep -rn the docs for the stale fact and fix every occurrence. 'I noted it in discoveries' is not the same as 'the docs are correct.' PR #379 Copilot review found 13 comments all tracing back to this failure: context knew the right facts, but multiple doc files still claimed the old ones.
The status.md test count (323) was wrong. Grep for 'tests' in the vitest output is not reliable — run npm test and read the summary line. Actual: 298 tests, 14 files.
Before claiming a commit is on main, run: git log --oneline origin/main | grep <hash>. Or: git branch --contains <hash>. The 15f232e commit was only on the PR branch.

The legacy comment count changes as refactoring happens. Always grep -c 'legacy' src/components/LobbyView.tsx rather than relying on a cached number. Was 41 at PR #379 creation, 26 on current branch as of 2026-05-02.
